items.text: Denver WR Jaylen Waddle (chest) left Week 7 in the fourth quarter and did not return; DL Zach Allen (hamstring) also went down but said he'll be fine. CB Pat Surtain II (ankle) has missed three games and says he'll 'possibly' play; S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) has missed two.
Kansas City WR Rashee Rice (hamstring) has missed two games and RT Jaylon Moore (concussion) missed Week 7; RB Brashard Smith went on IR; LT Josh Simmons (back) is on IR.
